concepts.def: John Hick's view that religions are different responses to same ultimate reality; controversial within faiths.
Rahner's 'anonymous Christians'; salvation through Christ but available outside explicit faith; Vatican II Lumen Gentium.
Salvation only through specific tradition; Calvinist 'extra ecclesiam nulla salus'; some evangelical Christians.
Vatican II declaration recognising truth in other religions; transformed Catholic-Jewish and Catholic-Muslim relations.
1942 UK organisation promoting dialogue after Holocaust awareness; archbishop and chief rabbi joint presidents.
138 Muslim scholars' letter to Christian leaders identifying love of God and neighbour as shared foundation.
